head: codex/5844-v092-wp24-article-series
title: [v0.92][WP-24] Ten-article launch series
body:
## Summary

- adds ten complete source-grounded launch articles, each with a source packet and editorial review
- adds cross-series claim controls, stop-before-publish disposition, and rollback evidence
- records complete Claude Opus 5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview editorial reviews

## Validation

- `ruby .csdlc/evidence/5844/validate-article-series.rb`
- `ruby .csdlc/evidence/5844/validate-article-series.rb --negative`
- `ruby .csdlc/evidence/5844/validate-article-series.rb --rollback`
- `bash adl/tools/test_medium_article_writer_skill_contracts.sh`
- typed C-SDLC issue validation and doctor
- exact-head pre-PR subagent review: no actionable findings

External Medium publication is not part of this PR and remains operator-only. Release-dependent claims remain gated on #5843 and must be refreshed before external publication.

Closes #5844
